# TDPdf v1.29.4.0

**A placed text box can now be edited again after you've moved it.**

Last release made it possible to move and resize a text box right after placing it — but going back to fix a typo in it afterward didn't work. Clicking it with the Text tool active just stacked a brand-new, empty box on top; clicking it with Edit Existing Text reported nothing there at all, because that tool only ever looks at the PDF's actual saved content, and a placed-but-unsaved text box isn't part of that until you save.

Both tools now recognize a click on a text box you already placed and reopen it for editing, the same way double-clicking it with the Select tool already did. Click your own text with whichever tool feels natural — it now does the same thing either way.
